description: This file manages the layout blocks and custom fields in the vtiger CRM system, including operations like adding, deleting, updating blocks and fields, changing order, and retrieving related list info.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering views in the CRM.

methods.name: InStrCount
methods.description: Counts occurrences of a substring within a string, case-sensitive option available.

methods.name: getFieldListEntries
methods.description: Retrieves list of custom fields organized by blocks for a given module.

methods.name: getListLeadMapping
methods.description: Fetches lead conversion mapping for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getCustomFieldSupportedModules
methods.description: Returns list of modules supporting custom fields.

methods.name: getModuleBlocks
methods.description: Gets all blocks for a specified module.

methods.name: changeFieldOrder
methods.description: Changes the order of blocks or fields based on user action (up/down).

methods.name: updateFieldProperties
methods.description: Updates properties of a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Deletes a custom field and associated data from database tables.

methods.name: addblock
methods.description: Adds a new block to a module's layout.

methods.name: deleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a specified block from the layout.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Creates a new custom field in a module.

methods.name: show_move_hiddenfields
methods.description: Moves fields between visible and hidden states within a block.

methods.name: getRelatedListInfo
methods.description: Retrieves related list information for a module.

methods.name: changeRelatedListOrder
methods.description: Reorders related list entries for a module.
